intent: The trap this row exists to catch: relevance-bound-exceeded is an LRF RESULT ISSUE, and CF-V0-022 says it MUST NOT appear in a Frontier error envelope. A complete LRF bound document translates to frontier-resource-exhausted.

cases.note: LRF returns a COMPLETE bound document whose only profile issue is relevance-bound-exceeded.
assertions: CF-V0-022: a complete LRF bound document containing only relevance-bound-exceeded maps to frontier-resource-exhausted.
CF-V0-022: relevance-bound-exceeded MUST NOT appear anywhere in the envelope — not as the code, not as a message, not as a nested field.
CF-V0-021: an aggregate LRF bound document is an operational Frontier failure, NEVER an open item.
CF-V0-023: no partial Frontier result is written.

cases.note: The contrasting row: an explicit unsupported-lrf-context is inherited exactly.
assertions: CF-V0-022 row 2: an explicit unsupported-lrf-context is emitted as the EXACT upstream code, not translated to a Frontier-owned code.
This case and the one above prove the two LRF rows are distinguished by whether the issue is a result issue or an explicit validation error.
